info.title: VecturaDB, compatible with the Chroma API
info.description: VecturaDB 1.0.0-preview.3.post1 as a .NET tool: the command vecturadb runs the VecturaDB server and CLI, without Python and without Docker. The first run downloads the executable of its platform from the GitHub release of VecturaDB, for Windows x64, Linux x64 and arm64 (glibc 2.17 and later), macOS x64 and arm64, and checks its SHA-256 hash. VecturaDB is an independent fork of Chroma, under the Apache License 2.0. The original code is copyright Chroma Inc. and its contributors. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Chroma Inc. CHROMA is a registered trademark of Chroma Inc., used here only to describe compatibility.

options.description: Emit machine-readable JSON

options.name: --help
options.description:
Print help
Run against a stopped Chroma instance for a consistent view of SQLite and index files. A hot SQLite rollback journal requires recovery and causes this read-only check to fail; recover a copy of the stopped store, including its SQLite sidecar files, and check that copy. Exit codes: 0 = no corruption or pending migration; 1 = findings; 2 = check failed.
